g.text: No Agent, Usage ID, capacity, Holder, or database writes
resolve Agent / model; restore messages; prepare safe prefix
No factory, model call, Usage ID, capacity, Holder, or writes
remove only this Holder; close; release capacity
Do not blindly restore idle or replay uncertain acceptance
compact without request SSE or control queue
persist Compaction Entry + Usage on success
result(true, actual Entry sequence) or failure
Caller cancellation cannot cancel accepted execution.
No public Command or HTTP route is added here.
Credentials are not retained for queued continuation.
